name: JustForFans
summary: Adult-first creator subscription platform with deep roots in gay and queer adult stars, offering internal performer search and co-star tagging.
ranking_rationale: Built specifically for explicit adult creators with smart co-star linking and real search; essential in gay/queer creator spaces, though less mainstream elsewhere.

pricing.model: Per-creator monthly subscriptions + clip store & tips
pricing.free_tier: Free account signup; subscriptions and clip unlocks priced per creator
pricing.notes: Each creator sets monthly subscription rates and individual video prices.

pros: Built-in search and co-star tagging make discovering performers easy
Deep roster of gay, queer, and pro adult studio performers
Supports both monthly subscriptions and standalone clip purchases
cons: Smaller mainstream straight creator catalog than OnlyFans
Interface feels utilitarian compared to Fansly
Video player and mobile browsing can feel slower on large feeds

facts.value: Per-creator monthly subscriptions and a-la-carte clips
Adult-first ruleset with co-star tagging and searchable creator directory
